hypotheses.summary: The third-party payment provider io-pay (IO Payments Ltd) began returning 503 for card lookups at the onset. The account page depends on it, so errors rose to 100% and latency rose to about 2s. Nothing changed in io-shop and its replicas are stable.

supporting_evidence.claim: PaymentProviderFailed: api.io-pay.example returned 503 for /v1/shoppers/shopper-39274-8-0/card at src/io_shop/payment_provider.py:95
io-pay: third-party, owned by IO Payments Ltd, at api.io-pay.example - called while the account page renders
get_changes: nothing changed in the 24h before the onset
error_rate 0.45 at 15:45, then 1.0 with p50 about 2045ms from 15:46; memory, cpu and request volume stayed flat
